page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question
Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter · 2 marks

steps.label: The equation
steps.margin_note: First mark. The equation itself, with the maximum speed — v(max), not just v.
steps.why: One photon gives its whole energy E to one electron. Part of it, W₀, is spent in removing the electron from the surface; the rest appears as the electron's kinetic energy, which is largest for an electron at the surface.
common_mistakes: Writing ½mv² without the maximum. Electrons from below the surface lose extra energy, so only the fastest ones satisfy the equation.
Writing E = W₀ − ½m v(max)². The kinetic energy is added to the work function, not subtracted.

recall.must_convey: That E equals W naught plus half m v max squared.
accept: E equals W naught plus half m v max squared
h nu equals work function plus maximum kinetic energy
photon energy equals work function plus kinetic energy
reject: E is the energy of the photon

steps.memory_tip: One photon, one electron: energy in = cost to leave + speed to spare.

steps.label: Meaning of each term
lines: Here E = hν is the energy of the incident
photon, where h is Planck's constant and ν is
the frequency of the radiation. W₀ is the
work function of the metal, and v(max) is the
maximum speed of the emitted photoelectrons,
so ½m v(max)² is their maximum kinetic energy.
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Name all three: E as the photon energy hν, W₀ as the work function, v(max) as the maximum speed.
steps.why: The equation carries its meaning in its terms. Writing E = hν also gives the second standard form, hν = W₀ + ½m v(max)², at no extra cost.
common_mistakes: Leaving a term unexplained. Each unexplained symbol costs part of the mark.
Calling W₀ the total energy of the electron. It is the minimum energy needed to remove the electron from the surface.

recall.must_convey: That E is the photon energy h nu, W naught is the work function, and v max is the maximum speed of the photoelectrons.
accept: W naught is the work function
v max is the maximum speed of the electrons
reject: E equals W naught plus half m v max squared

steps.memory_tip: Three symbols, three names: photon energy, work function, maximum speed.

insider_note: Write the equation, then spend a full sentence on each symbol — the second mark is for the meanings, not the algebra.
